    "Remove the redundant blue \"vsak popoldan ob 17.00\" kickboard badge from the hero, as the exact same time is already stated in the hero subtext and in the coral card right below.",
    "In the \"Do prve ure v treh korakih\" section, place a numbered marker above each of the three steps along the lane-rope graphic instead of just one unlabelled yellow float on the left.",
